sections.Purpose: We know how quickly each critical system has to come back, and how much data we can afford to lose. We can show that we meet those objectives. When a dependency fails, our systems lose some function but keep running.
sections.Scope:
All systems we operate and the data they contain, with depth set by how critical the system is. It covers designed-in fault tolerance and the ability to recover after failure.

A failure domain is the set of things that fail together: a disk, a rack, a data centre, a region.

Proving a restore needs the data the backup actually contains, so it runs in a controlled restore environment at production tier: the same access controls and the same data handling as production, and not an environment below production. Masked or synthesised data proves the mechanism and not the restore. [pol-DATA](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/0b33e205d64f9060cb2a2829d52c02981efd1834/examples/engineering/policies/security/data-data-protection.md) and [pol-ENVS](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/0b33e205d64f9060cb2a2829d52c02981efd1834/examples/engineering/policies/security/envs-environment-separation.md) bind that environment as production, and it is not an exception to either.

_Boundary: [pol-ENVS](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/0b33e205d64f9060cb2a2829d52c02981efd1834/examples/engineering/policies/security/envs-environment-separation.md) governs separation between environments, and [pol-DATA](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/0b33e205d64f9060cb2a2829d52c02981efd1834/examples/engineering/policies/security/data-data-protection.md) governs the handling of the data they contain. The restore environment is at production tier, so their rules about lower environments do not apply to it. [pol-INCR](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/0b33e205d64f9060cb2a2829d52c02981efd1834/examples/engineering/policies/operations/incr-incident-response.md) owns the response to an outage: deciding to invoke a recovery and running it. This policy owns being able to recover._
sections.Exceptions: A system whose whole state can be regenerated from source needs no data backup. Its recovery path is still defined and still exercised. Accepting a longer recovery objective than a system's criticality suggests is a recorded deviation under [pol-DEVI](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/0b33e205d64f9060cb2a2829d52c02981efd1834/examples/engineering/policies/governance/devi-deviations.md), owned by whoever will answer for the downtime.
